prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most kinds of changes because almost all categories have only 1 test so far.
home, new_flow changes did not work, consistently showing negative impacts across 2 tests (-2.6% average after noise correction).
finish, new_screen and choose_path, hint each won 1 test, but a second test of each showed no clear effect, so evidence remains mixed.
Predictions were generally too high overall compared to actual noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Pet Selection Redesign: Redesigns the friend picker screen to use a stage layout showcasing the desktop pet on a virtual pedestal with enhanced selection controls. (why: Adoption step drop-off is high (66.0% conversion, 89s median). A stage presentation gives visual prominence and excitement during pet selection.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Customization Sign-In Flow Reorder: Moves sign-in screen after pet selection and photo upload so users build emotional investment before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently happens before pet creation where users are less invested. Deferring sign-in improves overall completion.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Style Selector Screen: Adds a dedicated personality selection screen before adoption certificate generation, letting users select pet temperament options. (why: Adoption takes significant time (89s median) and lacks intermediate steps to configure pet behavior before final desktop deployment.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Actions Intro Redesign: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a split layout clearly highlighting desktop interaction shortcuts (hide, summon, chat). (why: Support receives multiple inquiries after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on their desktop.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Sync Guarantee Copy: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly inform returning users that existing pets will be automatically restored upon signing in. (why: Support theme analysis identified 8 user emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Setup Wait Info: Displays animated progress details and display setup reassurance on the waiting screen while pet assets load. (why: Support reports instances where pet fails to appear or app stalls, and waiting median time is 201s.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Overlay Control Toast Notification: Adds an actionable hint tip on the home intro screen detailing shortcut hotkeys for hiding and revealing the pet. (why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling and toggling desktop pet visibility.)

scores.note: Target step has highest drop-off; adoption redesign previously showed strong +8% lift, but evidence is thin and cost is high.

Strong evidence from both funnel and support emails, but redesign requires full screen changes.
